# Target tiers

<!-- generated by scripts/wj/target_tiers.wj from tests/conformance/backend_results.tsv and backend_ledger.tsv; do not edit -->

What each backend can run today, measured by the conformance programs (`tests/conformance`) and the spec's run cases (`tests/spec`) ([ADR-0007](adr/0007-target-tiers-conformance.md)).
**Tier 1**: every program passes, no exception. **Tier 2**: experimental; the programs that fail are listed below, exactly, with the reason. `not run`: the toolchain is not installed on the machine that measured; the commands to fill it in are at the end.

| Backend | Tier | conformance | spec run cases | failing | not run |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| rust | Tier 2 | 17/23 | 207/229 | 28 | 0 |
| javascript | Tier 2 | 17/23 | 204/229 | 31 | 0 |
| typescript | Tier 2 | 17/23 | 204/229 | 31 | 0 |
| go | Tier 2 | 16/23 | 197/229 | 39 | 0 |
| wasm | not measured | 0/23 | 0/229 | 0 | 252 |
| interpreter | Tier 2 | 18/23 | 229/229 | 5 | 0 |

## Not measured

- `wasm`: measured as the Rust backend's output built for `wasm32-wasip1` and run under `wasmtime` (the WebAssembly platform). A machine with `wasmtime` and `rustup target add wasm32-wasip1` runs it; any other machine records `not-run`. `wj build -t wasm` itself emits a browser library (a wasm-bindgen cdylib crate) that has no headless runner, so that target is not covered by this row.

- rust with wj 0.50.0+b2fe8d1256 (commit unknown unknown, clean, release, built 2026-11-16T15:31:01Z) on Darwin arm64

## Filling in what this machine could not run

A machine with the toolchains runs `wj run scripts/wj/target_tiers.wj run <wj-binary> --backend <name>` (names: rust, javascript, typescript, go, wasm, interpreter; needs rustc, node >= 22.6, go, wasmtime plus the wasm32-wasip1 target respectively), commits `tests/conformance/backend_results.tsv` and `docs/TARGET_TIERS.md`, and adds a ledger line with a reason for every failure.
